title: When AI Agents Pay and Sellers Monetize: Building x402 Apps on AWS — Anil Nadiminti, AWS
talk_summary: An AWS solutions architect pitches x402 (HTTP 402 machine-to-machine payments) and AWS AgentCore Payments/WAF AI traffic monetization for agent e-commerce. It is almost entirely a product/marketing talk about paying for web content, with no engineering techniques for building or operating agent systems.

takeaways.technique: Decouple payment/credential layer from the non-deterministic agent loop
takeaways.what_they_do: Wallet private keys are held in a KMS-backed token vault the agent cannot read, and payment authorization runs in a separate deterministic service rather than inside the agent's reasoning loop, so poisoned skills/inputs can't trigger arbitrary spend.
Payment sessions set a programmatic max spend and an expiry window (e.g. $5 over 30-60 days) enforced outside the agent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can create payment sessions where you can set the programmatically set the maximum amount ... or you can also set expiry time in minutes
